name: jr-no-ai-trailer
description: Stops commits and pull requests that carry an AI co-author line or a 'Generated with' footer, so your history stays yours.

allowTrailer.title: Allow AI co-author lines
allowTrailer.description: Let Co-Authored-By lines that name an AI through.

blockFooter.title: Block 'Generated with' footers
blockFooter.description: Also stop commits and pull requests whose message says it was generated with an AI tool.
